targetDefinition.Target: count of event registrations whose event's EventDate falls in month T; every registration counts (registration records carry no cancellation status; no-shows, Attended = false, are counted). The corpus has 78 reversed PROD-EVT fee lines on the generic SKUs PROD-EVT-CONFERENCE / PROD-EVT-WORKSHOP; the SKU does not identify the registration, but the OrderNumber does ("ORD-E-" + RegKey): 78 of 78 link to a registration, of which 73 are Attended = true. Those registrations are counted: the registration record stands and most were attended.

sizingNote: 91 monthly periods, the months the corpus holds (Ruling Q9: real data is what it is), 36 of them zero (no event that month). P2's rolling-origin design (K = 12 x H = 12 after 96 training months) needs 240 months, so it does not fit; the largest valid design with H = 12 non-overlapping windows and >= 24 training months is K = 5 origins (firstTestPeriod 31, i.e. 31 training months before the first test window; 60 scored forecasts). Lag-1 sample ACF (standard estimator) -0.0512, SE about 1/sqrt(n) = 0.1048.

source.worktreeNote: working tree differs from the commit only in files whose records are unchanged apart from sync metadata (the Task 06 enrollments sync); generated/enrollments/.enrollments.json: 4276 of 4276 records identical to HEAD apart from the added sync metadata
source.censoringRule: months from the corpus start month (min OrderDate, RegisteredOn) through the last month ending on or before REG_END (max RegisteredOn); later months are right-censored (registrations still accruing) and excluded
